---
name: Change request
about: Propose a bounded improvement to Sinon documentation, plugins, or tooling.
---

# Change Request

## Problem And Evidence

Describe the current limitation and provide concrete evidence.

## Proposed Scope

Describe the requested change, affected components, and exclusions.

## Acceptance Criteria

List observable conditions that establish completion.

## Ownership And Related Work

Name the owner and next action when known.
Link related issues or pull requests and identify overlapping work.

## Verification And Limitations

Describe the relevant checks and any unavailable validation.
